node.title: Sharp rate-half FPC5 cells are typed growing split-locator flats
node.statement: For one official rate-half sharp M=4,t=2 source and touched pair, the background-guarded locator image V_F has vector dimension ell-1. Its monic degree-(2ell-3) chart is an affine (ell-2)-flat of codimension ell-1, and exact contributors inject with unique numerator reconstruction into P(V_F) intersect D_(2ell-3)(C), where |C|=5ell-5. Primitive, untouched-petal, and first-owner conditions remain explicit filters. Dividing the maximal common gcd gives an exact bijection to a gcd-trivial flat over the punctured core, preserving projective dimension and changing affine codimension to ell-1-w. No polynomial count or tangent payment is claimed.
